_timeoutNote: 900s is calibrated for xhigh effort. At high effort a round takes about 90 seconds; at xhigh a real diff takes 5-8 minutes. If you change reasoning effort, change this too — otherwise every reviewer times out and the round is judged all_failed.
_modelNote: Both models are pinned here and deliberately do NOT follow each CLI's global default. Whatever the label says must actually be passed on the command line. Otherwise switching projects — or changing your CLI's global default months from now — silently runs a different model while the label keeps claiming the old one.
_ephemeralNote: --ephemeral tells codex not to persist session files to disk, which keeps ~/.codex/sessions/ clean; without it each round leaves roughly 1 MB of rollout behind. Remove it if you use a tool that measures codex token usage by scanning those rollout files — such tools cannot see an ephemeral session at all, so its cost goes unrecorded.
_probeNote: board-doctor derives its connectivity-probe arguments from `args` above using these rules, rather than keeping a second hand-maintained copy of each CLI's invocation shape (which drifts by construction). Listed flags are stripped — schema/output/prompt plumbing, plus the effort flag so the probe stays cheap — while `-m <model>` is deliberately KEPT: probing a different model than the meeting actually uses is exactly how 'doctor says ready, first meeting fails' happens.
